title: Ransom Note
description: Check if you can construct a ransom note from available magazine characters.

data.text: Given two strings `ransomNote` and `magazine`, return `true` if you can construct `ransomNote` from `magazine`. Each letter in `magazine` can only be used once.

data.title: Count magazine chars O(n)
int[26] frequency O(n)
What improved?
data.text: A fixed-size array replaces the dictionary. For lowercase English letters it is faster and avoids boxing/hashing overhead.
